info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Trader Position Information API
info.description: The Trader Position Information API provides access to detailed insights regarding trader positions within the wholesale trading environment. This endpoint allows users to retrieve specific position data by utilizing a unique identifier. Typical consumers include trading analysts and operations teams that require up-to-date information for monitoring and decision-making purposes. Leveraging this API ensures efficient management of trading positions and supports strategic financial operations.

get.summary: Retrieve details of trader position operations.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about specific trader position operations associated with the given resource. Utilize this API to monitor trader activities and manage positions effectively.
